# prime-inputmask

prime-rs: InputMask component (port of PrimeNG)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/inputmask) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-inputmask) · [Port notes](https://github.com/anton-avramchuk/prime-rs/blob/HEAD/docs/inputmask.md)

InputMask — port of `p-inputmask` from PrimeNG 21.1.10.

Masked input field: `9` — digit, `a` — letter (`character_pattern`), `*` — letter or digit, `?` — start of an optional
part, other characters are constants. The value is a `RwSignal<String>`: the masked text or (with `unmask`) only the entered
characters. The mask logic is the pure engine `Mask` (buffer, character checks, shifts on input and deletion).

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_inputmask::InputMask;

let value = RwSignal::new("5551234567".to_owned());
let html = Owner::new().with(|| view! { <InputMask mask="(999) 999-9999" value=value /> }.to_html());
assert!(html.contains("p-inputmask") && html.contains("value=\"(555) 123-4567\""));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-inputmask = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["inputmask"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
